newsitem.title: USA: Mining Services sets 15 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mining Services sets 15 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Mining Services International Corp said Tuesday that its board of directors has approved a 15 percent stock distribution to be issued December 13 to shareholders of record December 10.

Each eligible shareholder will be issued a stock certificate representing one Mining Services International common share for each 6.667 shares of common stock held on the record date, the company said.

The stock distribution, along with the 10 percent stock distribution issued in October, equals a 26.5 percent stock split for shareholders who have maintained their stock position in the company since September, the company said.
Separately, the company said its directors recommended that the company apply to trade on the Nasdaq National Market System.
